notes.title: v1.05h Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes:

 Added more juice when player or enemies take damage
 Adjusted deck icon tint for each class's colour scheme

notes.title: v1.05g Patch Notes
notes.content:
Graphical Improvements

 Added indicator to HP bar when damage is taken
 Characters squash and stretch when taking damage
[*[ Preloaded some graphics to reduce lag

notes.title: v1.05f Patch Notes
notes.content:
Balance Changes:

 Dodge now resets at the start of each turn
 Stun can no longer be stacked and only lasts one turn
 Ice Ball damage reduced to 2
 Adjusted some move frequencies for Troll and Drothmund Chief enemies

notes.title: v1.05e Patch Notes
notes.content:
Balance Changes:

 Fireball Storm/Meteor Storm damage reduced to 4/6
 Flaming Spear damage reduced to 12
 Inflame/Incense damage reduced to 5/8
 Scald damage reduced to 2
 Boiling Magma damage reduced to 4


Bugfixes:

 Fixing some card text spacing/overflow issues
 Adding screenshake when taking damage in dialogue
[/list[

notes.title: v1.05d Patch Notes
notes.content:
Minor adjustments/bugfixes:

 Adjusting card text spacing/overflow
 Preloading some additional sprites
 Fixing artifact tooltips not displaying correctly in treasure rooms
 Fixing enemy selection boxes not appearing after mousing off an enemy
 Adding small animation when activating a hero power
 Adjusting item tooltip position
 Adjusting move tooltip position for troll

notes.title: v1.05c patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks for playing and also for reporting the bugs you have found, we are only human and we do our best but some bugs do manage to slip through despite our best efforts. We have made some fixes and improvements in the last few days, which include:


 There was a nasty bug where the game appeared to randomly crash during battles due to a bizarre interaction with legacy code in a text display extension, we have updated everything and disabled legacy code so *hopefully* this is solved. Apologies if you were affected by this!
 Fixing Snake defensive animation
 Fixed bug with Counter Attack artifact
 Fixed card alpha when picking a card extremely quickly after a battle
 Fixed rare crash when enemy took damage with no cards in buffer
 Improved some dialogue
 Fixed unnecessary delay with Resolute artifact animation
 Fixed potion tooltip position in shop
 Fixed enemy move tooltips not updating when stunned from certain cards

notes.title: Demo v1.05 Release! Animations, New Campaign, Balance and Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have just released the huge 1.05 update for the Cardseer demo. We have rewritten large portions of the game essentially from scratch for improved stability, performance and features, along with an overhauled cadmpaign and graphical improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/983794148e33b6611c4486e744bc625a8792afca.gif

This update includes:

 Animated characters
 Completely new Vanguard campaign, including 4 regions
 Improved Gauntlet and Campaign maps, more variety of Gauntlet maps
 Rebalanced cards and improved card/tooltip text
 More powerful artifacts to discover
 Much more to discover for yourself

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/3e025667954c04f0b801e4a8faf6b8cd1604a60c.gif

This is also a good time to announce that we will be participating in the Steam October Next Fest (starting on the 3rd of October), so if you want to support Cardseer's development make sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends!

Until next time,
Aventia Entertainment

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/93b8fbb6a3eddb4a395ddd75aa9d790b8901193a.png
Hello everyone!

We have just released version 1.0.4 for the Aventia Demo, or should I say, Cardseer Demo. As you may have noticed, we have decided to change the name of the game from Aventia to Cardseer. We believe the new name is more appropriate and fitting to the game, and we hope the change doesn’t cause too much confusion. The update also includes:

Overhaul to card text: You will find the card text to be more verbose and easily understandable, with less cryptic keywords.
Added status icons for some hero power effects, replacing the additional temporary text from cards
Improved tutorial graphics
Swapped the art for Honed Claw and Sharpened Claw
Adjusting position for many menu UI elements
General UI text and font improvements
General Bug Fixes


V1.0.4a HOTFIX:


Fixing bug with power card tooltips


Have Fun!

EDIT: There may be some hiccups with the demo installation if you have played prior to patch 1.0.4. If the game won't start for you, try reinstalling and that should do the trick. If you haven't downloaded the demo before this patch you should be unaffected.

notes.title: Aventia Demo Out Now
notes.content:
Aventia Entertainment is proud to release the demo of our debut game "Aventia" to the world! Aventia is a roguelike deck-building game with a variety of classes and game modes, so you can play the way that you want to!
